description: Crop computation (SPEC SCR-11, §10.4, D-35, AC-196; ARCH §11.5, §12.5; D-89). Single source of truth for web/src/core/boxes.test.ts (Vitest) and the iOS port (XCTest, AC-352). Each case has an `fn` naming the function under test, a human `name`, its inputs and an `expect` object.
conventions: Rects are {x, y, w, h} in master pixels; boxes are the PADDED boxes a mask would cover (D-89). W×H is the master. A non-finite number is written as the string "NaN" etc.; a box with a non-finite field or a negative w or h makes the call fail (`expect: {throws: true}`, D-97), it is never skipped.

minimalCrop(side, boxes, W, H): boxes are first clamped to W×H and zero-area ones dropped (none left → {ok:false, reason:'no_boxes'}). px is the smallest whole number of pixels removed from `side` so that no box remains: top = ceil(max(y + h)), bottom = ceil(H − min(y)), left = ceil(max(x + w)), right = ceil(W − min(x)). px > 0.4 × that dimension → {ok:false, reason:'too_much'} (exactly 40% is allowed). Otherwise {ok:true, side, px, rect} where rect is the image that remains.

bestCrop(boxes, W, H): minimalCrop on every side; the ok result with the smallest share px / dimension wins; ties keep the earlier side in the order top, bottom, left, right. No ok side → {ok:false, reason} (too_much, or no_boxes when there are none).

The rules plan (SPEC §10.4) asks for a crop only when every clue cited by some exact or likely target (or by the closest-band hypothesis) is non-removable; those clues' padded boxes are the input to bestCrop, and too_much means crop 'none' with copy.fix.unremovable.

cases.name: top: down to the lowest box edge
bottom: up to the highest box edge
left: past the right-most box edge
right: past the left-most box edge
a fractional edge crops up to the next whole pixel
bottom: a fractional edge crops up to the next whole pixel (800 − 700.6 = 99.4 → 100)
left: a fractional edge crops up to the next whole pixel (119.3 → 120)
right: a fractional edge crops up to the next whole pixel (1000 − 900.7 = 99.3 → 100)
a box partly outside the image is clamped first
exactly 40% is allowed
one pixel over 40% is refused (copy.fix.cropTooMuch)
the cap is 40% of THAT dimension (bottom 400 of 800 is 50%)
boxes wholly outside the image count as none
a malformed box (non-finite) fails closed instead of being skipped
a negative extent fails closed
no boxes
rules plan (AC-196): every clue the exact target cites is non-removable (a skyline and a mountain ridge near the top) → crop from the top
the smallest SHARE wins, not the fewest pixels (right 200/2000 beats top 100/600)
a tie keeps the earlier side (top before left)
rules plan: a clue in the middle fits no side → too_much (crop 'none', copy.fix.unremovable)
a NaN box fails closed (it is never ignored)
no boxes
